text:
Marco (Sales): quick ask — Nimbus AI is asking for an extension on their startup trial. originally 30k tokens, used ~8k. asking for +50k to finish a 2-week POC because their security review slowed them down. they say they'll convert to a $1.2k/month committed plan if we give the extension through end of Q2. can we grant credits or do a credit note? @DealDesk Bot @Kira (Solutions)
Kira (Solutions): +1 — SE note: their eval is blocked by SAML/SCIM questions; dev team needs SSO proof-of-concept. asked eng to spin a short demo by EOD tmw. if we do credits, we should tie to a signed MSA/commit. also they want embeddings for 10k vectors during POC.
Marco (Sales): thanks — customer is early-stage (YC alumni). CTO said security questionnaire delayed because of legal review, so timeline shifted. they’re sensitive to startup program precedent tho. prefer to keep it as a one-time promo credit vs changing billing.
Sylvia (Security): can you drop the SQ here? I need to confirm data flows before we approve expanded token access. also need to confirm whether logs contain PII. please paste the submitted doc or link.
Marco (Sales): attaching snippet — they answered: "no PII in training data; logs masked at source". paste: ```Log retention: 7d; masked user ids; no raw customer data persisted.``` link: https://internal-upload/nimbus-sq
Sylvia (Security): I can fast-track a thumbs-up if masking is enforced and S3 buckets are read-only to team. Send me the S3 policy or a screenshot of the bucket ACLs.
DealDesk Bot: Policy: startup program provides up to $5k in credits automatically. Exceptions >$5k require manager approval + simple commitment (min $1k/month) or legal signature. For ad-hoc credits, deal desk prefers a credit note tied to a signed PO. See: /policies/startup-credits
Marco (Sales): request would be ~50k tokens (~$650 at hosted rate) — under $5k. can we do an admin grant now while we get the doc signed? customer will sign a short POC addendum if we extend.
Finance Bot: hold: any credit grant requires a ledger entry and expiring credit note (90d). we can issue a promo credit of $700 but finance needs the signed POC agreement before we convert to a non-refundable credit. otherwise mark as conditional promo.
Ryan (CSM): from CS side, we should offer the SSO demo + 30 extra days as a stopgap. that buys time for security to review and reduces risk. also offer a 20% onboarding discount if they sign 6 months commit after POC.
Kira (Solutions): proposed approach: 1) Grant conditional promo credit $700 (50k tokens equivalent) with expiry 90d. 2) Require POC addendum (one-paragraph) signed within 14 days that commits to trial conversion discussion; 3) SE will deliver SSO demo within 48h. If legal/security sign-off fails, credit voided.
Marco (Sales): sounds good. @DealDesk Bot — can you pre-approve and route to manager for final sign-off? i'll attach POC addendum and SQ evidence.
DealDesk Bot: Escalation logged: DD-2026-401. Manager approval required (ops_mgr@redwood). Please attach POC addendum link. Estimated response 24-48h.
Sylvia (Security): once you drop the S3 ACL screenshot I can sign off same day. also request: limit embeddings quota to 10k vectors during POC (we can enforce at routing layer).
Marco (Sales): dropped screenshot link: https://internal-upload/s3-acl-nimbus.png — marking embedding quota 10k in deal notes.
DealDesk Bot: Manager approved conditional promo of $700 (token credit). Condition: signed POC addendum within 14 days and security sign-off. Credit will auto-expire in 90 days if conditions not met. Ticket: DD-2026-401 -> approved_by: ops_mgr
Marco (Sales): amazing — passing to customer now. thx everyone :rocket:
Ryan (CSM): I'll follow-up with an onboarding checklist once the demo is scheduled. :thumbsup:
